inlines.v: OMNIS'CIENCE, OMNIS'CIENCY, noun [Latin omnis, all, and scientia, knowledge.] The quality of knowing all things at once; universal knowledge; knowledge unbounded or infinite. omniscience is an attribute peculiar to God.
